formats.key: LoanRequest(address collateralAddress,uint256 initialCollateralAmount,uint256 loanAmount,bytes32 loanId,uint64 loanInterestRate,uint64 loanTerm,address underlyingAddress)
effects: The only verifying contract in the descriptor (0x72e9…ada13) is the plain SMARTCREDIT ERC-20 token. It has no ecrecover, no EIP-712 domain and no LoanRequest type, so it never checks this signature and nothing on-chain there changes because of it.

Judging by the type, whatever really consumes the message (a SmartCredit 'Credit Line' contract or backend that is not in the directory) would commit the signer to a loan request: initialCollateralAmount of collateralAddress posted as collateral, loanAmount of underlyingAddress borrowed at loanInterestRate for loanTerm, under loanId. None of this can be confirmed from the code provided.
formats.shown: The title is just the brand 'SmartCredit.io'. Below it are seven raw fields: collateral token address, collateral amount, loan amount, loan ID, interest rate, 'Load Term' and underlying token address. Numbers have no decimals or units and addresses have no token names.

findings.title: LoanRequest is bound to the SMARTCREDIT ERC-20 token, which never verifies EIP-712 signatures or a LoanRequest type.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json context.eip712.deployments = [{chainId 1, address 0x72e9d9038ce484ee986fea183f8d8df93f9ada13}], domain {name 'Credit Line', version '1.0.0'}. contracts/1-0x72e9…/src/SMARTCREDIT.sol: contract SMARTCREDIT is ERC20 with only a constructor calling _mint. The file has no ecrecover, DOMAIN_SEPARATOR or LoanRequest typehash. The domain name 'Credit Line' does not match the token's name 'SMARTCREDIT Token'.
findings.fix: Bind the descriptor to the contract that actually verifies the 'Credit Line' domain (the SmartCredit credit-line contract) and use its real domain fields. If the signature is only checked off-chain, remove the deployment binding to the token.

findings.title: LoanRequest intent 'SmartCredit.io' only names the brand, not that the signer is requesting a collateralised loan.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json format intent: "SmartCredit.io". There is no interpolatedIntent. case 0 screen.intent: "SmartCredit.io".
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Request loan', plus an interpolatedIntent such as 'Borrow {loanAmount} against {initialCollateralAmount} collateral'.

findings.title: LoanRequest shows collateral and loan amounts as raw integers, although their token addresses are in the message.
findings.evidence: fields initialCollateralAmount and loanAmount use format 'raw'. case 0 shows 'Initial Collateral Amount' = 2500000000000000000 (WETH, 18 decimals) and 'Loan Amount' = 4000000000 (USDC, 6 decimals).
findings.fix: Use format tokenAmount with params.tokenPath 'collateralAddress' for initialCollateralAmount and params.tokenPath 'underlyingAddress' for loanAmount.

findings.title: LoanRequest shows collateral and underlying token addresses as raw hex instead of token names.
findings.evidence: fields collateralAddress and underlyingAddress use format 'raw'. case 0 shows 0xC02a…6Cc2 and 0xA0b8…eB48 without the WETH/USDC names.
findings.fix: Use format addressName with params.types ['token'], or fold the tokens into the amount fields through tokenPath.

findings.title: LoanRequest loanTerm has the typo label 'Load Term' and shows a raw number that looks like a timestamp.
findings.evidence: field path loanTerm label 'Load Term', format 'raw'. case 0 shows 1777680000, which reads as a Unix time in May 2026 and not as a duration.
findings.fix: Rename the label to 'Loan term'. Use format date (encoding timestamp) if it is a maturity date, or duration if it is a length of time.

findings.title: LoanRequest interest rate appears as a raw integer with no stated unit; the scale cannot be confirmed from the code.
findings.evidence: field loanInterestRate format 'raw'. case 0 shows 850 (possibly basis points, 8.5%). No source in the directory defines the scale.
findings.fix: Once the consuming contract's scale is known, use format unit (e.g. decimals 2, base '%') or say the unit in the label.

findings.title: LoanRequest effects cannot be confirmed because the contract that consumes the signature is not provided.
findings.evidence: The only source in contracts/ is SMARTCREDIT.sol, a plain ERC-20. The code that acts on a signed LoanRequest (collateral pull, loan payout, interest terms) is not in the directory.
findings.fix: Point the descriptor at the verified consuming contract so its effects can be checked.

couldNotCheck: The contract (or backend) that verifies the 'Credit Line' 1.0.0 EIP-712 domain and acts on a LoanRequest is not in the directory. The only deployment given is the SMARTCREDIT ERC-20 token at 1:0x72e9d9038ce484ee986fea183f8d8df93f9ada13, which never verifies this signature. So the collateral, loan and interest effects of signing could not be checked.

LoanRequest(address collateralAddress,ui.worst: LoanRequest is bound to the SMARTCREDIT ERC-20 token, which never verifies EIP-712 signatures or a LoanRequest type.
